sampling_method: Random sample from each sequential Parquet batch, followed by a capped sample.
psi_method: Standard numeric features: up to ten quantile bins derived from reference sample. newbalanceOrig: separate exact-zero bin plus up to five reference-derived quantile bins for non-zero observations. Conditional non-zero PSI is reported separately when sample-size requirements are met. Epsilon smoothing is used.
ks_method: Two-sided two-sample KS test on sampled observations.
important_notes: PSI and KS values are sample-based estimates.
KS p-values can be highly sensitive to sample size.
Statistical significance does not imply business importance.
Fraud-only comparisons use observed fraud labels retrospectively.
Test data is used for descriptive analysis only.
No model retraining or threshold tuning was performed.
PSI interpretation bands are heuristics, not universal standards.
